info.title: Numo orderbook API
info.description: REST endpoints exposed by Numo's markets-service and execution-service for dollar stablecoins. Real-time book, trades, and order streams are served over the WebSocket endpoint documented in the WebSocket streams reference.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Market identifier, as GET /v1/markets lists it: cNGN-USDC, or a future such as USDC-cNGN-30NOV26. Matched exactly. The pre-rename identifier USDCcNGN-SPOT is accepted as a deprecated alias until 2027-01-06; a request using one is answered under the canonical identifier with Deprecation: true and X-Canonical-Market response headers.

200.description: Top of book for a market

Deprecation.description: Present, with the value true, only when the request named the market by a deprecated alias (USDCcNGN-SPOT). Those aliases are removed on 2027-01-06.

X-Canonical-Market.description: Present only alongside Deprecation: the canonical identifier the body is answered under, cNGN-USDC.

400.description: unknown_market: the request named no listed market. Either the symbol, or the asset_address and sub_id pair, matched nothing (identifiers match exactly; the deprecated USDCcNGN-SPOT still resolves until 2027-01-06), or the request named no market at all. Before 2026-10-08 both cases returned the spot book.

unknown.summary: An identifier the venue does not list

get.description: One ticker per enabled market, in the pair orientation GET /v1/markets advertises: base_currency is the asset priced, target_currency the asset it is priced in. On cNGN-USDC that is cNGN priced in USDC, the same orientation as GET /v1/book and GET /v1/trades; nothing is inverted. Prices are USDC per cNGN to 10 decimal places: last_price, high, low and bid round down, ask rounds up, so the ticker agrees with the orderbook's top levels. base_volume is cNGN to 6 decimal places, target_volume USDC to 18, both rounded down. Use this endpoint, not stats_24h, for a market data listing. Responses are cached for up to 5 seconds and carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=5, so polling faster than that returns the same data.

200.description: Tickers for every enabled market, sorted by ticker_id

get.description: Resting orders aggregated into price levels in the advertised pair orientation. On cNGN-USDC, bids are orders buying cNGN and asks are orders selling it, priced in USDC per cNGN with quantities in cNGN. Bid prices round down and ask prices round up to 10 decimal places, and quantities round down to 6, so no level shows a better price or more size than is resting. Orders whose prices round to the same level are summed; a level whose quantity rounds to 0 is dropped. At most the first 1000 resting orders per side are read. Responses are cached for up to 5 seconds and carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=5, so polling faster than that returns the same data.

parameters.name: ticker_id
parameters.description: A ticker_id from GET /v1/integrations/tickers: cNGN-USDC, matched exactly. The deprecated USDCcNGN-SPOT is accepted until 2027-01-06 and answered under the canonical ticker_id with Deprecation: true and X-Canonical-Market headers. An unknown value is rejected rather than answered with another market.

Deprecation.description: Present, with the value true, only when the request named the market by a deprecated alias (USDCcNGN-SPOT). Those aliases are removed on 2027-01-06.

X-Canonical-Market.description: Present only alongside Deprecation: the canonical identifier the body is answered under, cNGN-USDC.

400.description: Missing or unknown ticker_id, or depth out of range

get.description: Fills newest first, in the advertised pair orientation. On cNGN-USDC, price is USDC per cNGN to 10 decimal places, base_volume is the cNGN traded to 6 decimal places and target_volume the USDC it traded for to 18, all rounded to nearest. type is the taker's side in cNGN. Responses are cached for up to 5 seconds and carry Cache-Control: public, max-age=5, so polling faster than that returns the same data.

get.description: The authenticated owner's orders in every status (active, matching, filled, cancelled, expired), newest first. The owner is taken from the signed X-Numo-Auth frame, never from a parameter. Filled orders, and any cancelled or expired order that traded, are retained indefinitely; cancelled and expired orders with no fills for 30 days.

parameters.name: X-Numo-Auth
parameters.description: Base64url-encoded JSON auth frame {address, signature, nonce, issued_at, expiry}, signed with personal_sign over the order-history message. See the endpoint page for the exact message.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before value from the previous page, to page to older orders.

200.description: One page of the owner's orders, newest first

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or mismatched auth frame

409.description: Duplicate order, or an order on a future past its last trade time

422.description: A future order the chain could not settle: its limit is outside the fill band (error starts fill_band:), its account is not under the MarginEngine, or reduce_only has nothing to reduce.

503.description: A future order the venue cannot check right now: the index is stale, or the band, the series or the account's manager could not be read. Retry shortly.

get.description: The fills on the authenticated owner's orders, newest first. Takes the same X-Numo-Auth frame as GET /v1/orders; the owner is taken from it, never from a parameter. A trade between two of the owner's orders is listed once per order.

parameters.name: X-Numo-Auth
parameters.description: Base64url-encoded JSON auth frame {address, signature, nonce, issued_at, expiry}, signed with personal_sign over the order-history message. The same frame GET /v1/orders accepts.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before value from the previous page, to page to older fills.

200.description: One page of the owner's fills, newest first

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or mismatched auth frame

get.description: An account's futures positions in every listed series, and its margin under the MarginEngine, read from chain. Positions are public on chain, so no signature is needed. A futures field the venue could not read is left out, and the rest of the response is still served: treat an absent field as unknown, not as zero.

parameters.name: subaccount_id
parameters.description: The subaccount to read, as a decimal integer.

400.description: subaccount_id missing or not a non-negative integer

post.description: Withdraws from a subaccount held by Matching with one signed WithdrawalModule action. The venue verifies the signature and that Matching records action.owner as the owner, simulates the withdrawal, and submits it through Matching.verifyAndMatch. Tokens are paid to action.owner. Every check fails closed.

200.description: Submitted. receipt_status timeout means broadcast but not yet confirmed.

400.description: Malformed or off-policy request, or the subaccount is not deposited in Matching

401.description: The signature does not authorize the action

403.description: Matching records another owner for the subaccount

422.description: The executor refused it: the simulation reverted, and revert names the revert

429.description: A withdrawal for this owner is in progress, or more than five were requested in a minute

502.description: Outcome unknown: check the balance before signing another withdrawal

503.description: Withdrawals are not enabled, or the signature or owner could not be read

post.description: Opens a trading account under the MarginEngine (subaccount_id 0) and funds it, or tops one up, with one signed DepositModule action. The venue verifies the action, reads the nonce, ownership and the owner's token balance and allowance, the issuer's freezes and pause, and the cNGN cap from the chain, simulates, and submits it through Matching.verifyAndMatch, paying the gas.

200.description: Submitted. receipt_status timeout means broadcast but not yet confirmed; resubmit the same request for the outcome.

400.description: Malformed or off-policy request, or a chain pre-check failed: a spent nonce, not your account, an account not under the MarginEngine, or too little USDC balance or allowance. error says what to do; revert names the on-chain revert when there was one.

401.description: The signature does not authorize the action

422.description: The simulation reverted for a reason not listed under 400, and revert names it

202.description: The same signed deposit is already being submitted; status is pending. Read it later with GET /v1/deposits/{action_hash}.

429.description: A deposit for this owner is in progress, more than three were requested in a minute, or six were submitted in the last hour (Retry-After)

502.description: Could not confirm whether the deposit was submitted

503.description: Deposits are not enabled, or paused: the venue's gas wallet is below its reserve, or the hour's sponsored gas budget is spent

get.description: A deposit's record by the EIP-712 hash of its signed action (Matching.getActionHash). A submitted deposit is re-read from the chain first, so a receipt that timed out resolves on the next read.

503.description: Deposits are not enabled, or the record could not be read

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order_id returned when the order was created

200.description: Current status and fill snapshot for the order

post.summary: Cancel order by owner and nonce

market.description: The market identifier: cNGN-USDC (spot), or USDC-cNGN-<DDMONYY> for a future, for example USDC-cNGN-30NOV26. Always the canonical identifier, whichever alias the request used. This is the value to pass as symbol, market and ticker_id.

base_asset_symbol.description: The asset priced. cNGN on spot; USDC on a future, which is priced in cNGN per USDC.

quote_asset_symbol.description: The asset prices are quoted in. USDC on spot; cNGN on a future.

expiry_timestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the market expires. Present on a future, where it is also the sub_id; omitted on cNGN-USDC.

display_name.description: Human-readable pair name. It equals the market identifier. Use market as the identifier; this is for display.

display_label.description: Unit of every price on the market.

tick_size.description: Smallest price increment. Order prices are normalized against it.

min_size.description: Smallest tradable size. Order amounts are normalized against it, and an amount below it normalizes to zero and is rejected.

contract_multiplier.description: 1 on spot. On a future, the USDC notional of one contract: 1000.

pricing_model.description: How the instrument's price relates to its underlying. All current markets are linear.

price_semantics.description: Interpretation of the raw price fields. Mirrors pricing_model.

display_price_kind.description: How a client should render the price. All current markets are direct.

display_semantics.description: Interpretation of the displayed price. Mirrors display_price_kind.

last_trade_timestamp.description: Unix seconds of the most recent fill.

order_entry_spec.description: Identifies the ui_intent contract the market accepts: cngn_usdc_spot_v1 on cNGN-USDC, an identity mapping: the engine order is the ui_intent. Omitted on futures, which take raw engine values only. The retired usdc_cngn_* specs are refused.

ui_price_unit.description: Unit of ui_intent.price. The same as engine_price_unit.

ui_size_unit.description: Unit of a size: cNGN amount on spot, USDC of notional on a future (1,000 a contract).

ui_side_meaning.description: What each side does, in cNGN. On spot: BUY acquires cNGN and pays USDC; SELL delivers cNGN and receives USDC. On a future a BUY (long) gains when cNGN weakens against USD, a SELL (short) when it strengthens.
ui_side_meaning.example: BUY acquires cNGN and pays USDC; SELL delivers cNGN and receives USDC.

engine_price_unit.description: Unit of the raw price and limit_price fields.

engine_amount_unit.description: Unit of the raw desired_amount, filled_amount and size fields.

engine_side_policy.description: How ui_intent.side maps to the engine side. Always same_as_ui.

ui_size_to_engine.description: Size conversion formula. The identity; on a future the signed amount is ui_size x 1e15 (amount_scale).

trade_module_address.description: The TradeModule an order for this market must name in action_json.module. Spot and the futures share it.

quote_asset_address.description: The USDC CashAsset: what spot is settled in, and what fees, margin and any VM shortfall on a future are paid in.

margin_manager_address.description: The MarginEngine: the manager a trading account for this market must be under. Spot and the futures share it.

amount_scale.description: What one unit of size is signed as in action_json.data: 1e18 on spot (one cNGN), 1e15 on a future (one USDC of notional, 0.001 contract).

fill_band_enforced.description: Futures only, always true: the venue admits an order and fills it only inside the fill band, as the chain does.

fill_band_low.description: Futures only: the lowest price, in cNGN per USDC, the chain accepts a fill at now. Omitted while the band cannot be read.

fill_band_high.description: Futures only: the highest price, in cNGN per USDC, the chain accepts a fill at now. Omitted while the band cannot be read.

future.description: Futures only: the series' live state read from chain. Omitted on spot.

created_at.description: When the order was accepted onto the book.

TradeStats24h.description: Stats over the trailing 24 hours, computed from the market's fills on each request: a rolling window, not the UTC day. Prices are raw engine values in USDC per cNGN, the same orientation as every other price. Every field is omitted when nothing traded in the window.

change.description: Last price minus the window's first traded price, in engine price units.

high.description: Highest price in the window, in USDC per cNGN.

last.description: Most recent engine price in the window.

low.description: Lowest price in the window, in USDC per cNGN.

volume.description: Summed fill size in cNGN, the base asset.

quote_volume.description: Summed fill notional (price x size) in USDC, the quote asset. Use this, not volume, for a USDC figure.

FutureMarketState.description: A future series as the chain has it. Prices are cNGN per USDC, up to 18 decimal places. An absent optional field could not be read: treat it as unknown, not as zero.

expiry_timestamp.description: Unix seconds the series expires and settles. Also its sub_id.

last_trade_time.description: Unix seconds after which no order is accepted and nothing fills. One hour before expiry.

listed.description: The series is listed on its FutureAsset.

trading_open.description: Whether the matcher crosses orders: the series is listed, unsettled and before its last trade time, the TradeModule treats it as a dated future, the MarginEngine has a position cap on it and is not paused. Orders are accepted and rest while it is false.

trading_closed_reason.description: Why trading_open is false. Omitted while it is true.

mark_price.description: The mark variation margin is settled against.

index_price.description: The index the fill band is centred on: 1 / the on-chain USDC-per-cNGN index.

band_width.description: The fill band's half-width as a fraction of the index: 0.1 is the index -/+ 10%. It narrows to 0.01 over the last 14 days before expiry.

band_status.description: ok when the band was read. index_stale: the index feed is past its heartbeat, so the chain refuses every fill and the venue refuses new orders. unreadable: the read failed.

SpotUIIntent.description: The order in the units a UI displays: side in cNGN, price in USDC per cNGN to 10 decimal places, size in cNGN to 6. Since the cNGN-USDC orientation this equals engine_order; only the scale differs.

side.description: buy acquires cNGN and pays USDC; sell delivers cNGN and receives USDC. Equals the engine side.

price.description: Price in USDC per cNGN, to 10 decimal places. Equals the engine price.

size.description: Size in cNGN, to 6 decimal places. Equals the engine amount.

SpotContract.description: Present on cNGN-USDC. Restates the raw engine order at display scales. ui_intent and engine_order are the same order in the same orientation (USDC per cNGN, sized in cNGN); ui_intent prints the price to 10 decimal places and the size to 6, engine_order carries the engine's 18.

engine_order.description: The order as the matching engine sees it: cNGN traded against the quote asset, at the engine's full scale.

price.description: Engine price in USDC per cNGN.

balance_delta.description: Balance change if the order fills completely, signed, to 6 decimal places. A buy of size S at price P is cngn +S and usdc -S x P; a sell is cngn -S and usdc +S x P.

order_entry_spec.description: cNGN-USDC only — sending it on an order for any other market, including a future, is rejected. Optional: omit both this and ui_intent to submit raw engine values. If either is present, this must be the market's own spec — cngn_usdc_spot_v1 on spot — and ui_intent becomes required. The retired usdc_cngn_spot_v1 and usdc_cngn_perp_v1 specs, and the other market's spec, are refused.

ui_intent.description: cNGN-USDC only — sending it on an order for any other market, including a future, is rejected. Optional, and paired with order_entry_spec: sending one without the other is rejected. When present, the service derives side, limit_price and desired_amount from it as the identity: side = ui_intent.side, limit_price = ui_intent.price (USDC per cNGN), desired_amount = ui_intent.size (cNGN). If you send those fields as well, each must equal its ui_intent counterpart or the order is rejected.

reduce_only.description: Futures only: the order may only shrink the account's position in the series. Refused on spot (400), and refused (422) when the account has no position or the order is on the same side as it. The matcher clamps each fill so it never crosses through zero.

trade_id.description: The trade this fill belongs to, as on GET /v1/trades.

liquidity.description: taker when your order crossed the book, maker when it rested and was hit.

side.description: Your order's side: buy acquired cNGN and paid USDC. Equals spot_contract.ui_intent.side.

price.description: Price the fill executed at, in USDC per cNGN, at the engine's scale.

size.description: Size filled, in cNGN, at the engine's scale.

fee.description: What your order paid on the fill, in USDC. 0 for a maker fill; for a taker, the fee charged. Absent when not known.

tx_hash.description: The Base transaction that settled the fill. Absent for fills recorded before it was stored.

mark_price.description: Futures only: the mark the fill settled against, cNGN per USDC: the mark in force when the fill's transaction ran. Absent on other markets and when the venue could not read it.

vm_cngn.description: Futures only: the variation margin the fill settled at once, in cNGN to your account (negative when paid): your side × the USDC notional × (mark_price − price). Absent whenever mark_price is.

spot_contract.description: The fill at display scales: ui_intent.size is the cNGN that changed hands, ui_intent.price the USDC per cNGN it traded at, and balance_delta what the fill moved.

next_before.description: Pass as before to fetch older fills. Absent on the last page.

action.description: A Matching Action for the WithdrawalModule, signed with EIP-712 against the Matching domain.

subaccount_id.description: Base-10 subaccount id, deposited in Matching.

nonce.description: Base-10 uint256, unused by this owner in the WithdrawalModule.

data.description: abi.encode(address asset, uint256 amount): the wrapped asset, and the amount in the token's native decimals.

expiry.description: Unix seconds; in the future and at most one hour ahead.

owner.description: The subaccount's owner as Matching records it. Tokens are paid here.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature by signer: 65 bytes, or longer for an ERC-1271 wallet.

action.description: A Matching Action for the DepositModule, signed with EIP-712 against the Matching domain.

subaccount_id.description: Base-10. 0 opens a new account under the MarginEngine; otherwise your account to top up.

nonce.description: Base-10 uint256, unused by this owner in the DepositModule.

data.description: abi.encode(uint256 amount, address asset, address managerForNewAccount). asset is the cash asset (USDC, minimum 10) or the cNGN escrow 0x37c976bb5d4887a714ef19AF6B83e34fe2f37c98 (cNGN, minimum 15,000); amount is in the token's 6-decimal base units (1000000000 = 1,000), explicit and at least that minimum; managerForNewAccount is the MarginEngine 0xA19E296021c9DF25b90D96C2A0793CC3D0800758, or zero for a top-up.

expiry.description: Unix seconds; in the future and at most one hour ahead.

owner.description: Your address: the tokens are pulled from here, and you own the account.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature by signer: 65 bytes, or longer for an ERC-1271 wallet.

permit.description: Optional EIP-2612 permit on Base USDC from owner to the DepositModule, instead of a prior approve. USDC only: cNGN has no permit, and a cNGN deposit carrying one is refused. The venue submits it with the DepositModule as spender, and skips it when the allowance already covers the deposit.

value.description: Base-10, 6-decimal USDC base units; at least the deposit amount.

signature.description: 65-byte EIP-712 signature over USDC's Permit, by owner.

action_hash.description: EIP-712 hash of the signed action (Matching.getActionHash); the key for GET /v1/deposits/{action_hash}.

subaccount_id.description: The account credited: your new account when subaccount_id was 0. Absent until the receipt is known.

asset.description: The wrapped asset credited: the cash asset (USDC) or the cNGN escrow.

amount.description: The deposit in the token, with 6 decimal places.

amount_units.description: The same amount in the token's 6-decimal base units, as signed.

credited_e18.description: What the account's balance of the asset rises by, at the ledger's 18 decimals.

amount_usdc.description: Same as amount; USDC deposits only.

credited_cash_e18.description: Same as credited_e18; USDC deposits only.

permit_tx_hash.description: The permit's transaction, when the deposit carried a permit and it was needed.

status.description: rejected: refused before anything was sent; the same request may be resubmitted.

permit_tx_hash.description: The permit's transaction, when the deposit carried a permit and it was needed.

revert.description: The revert the simulation hit, e.g. WERC_CannotBeNegative.

cancel_reason.description: Why the order was cancelled; absent otherwise.

cancelled_at.description: When the order was cancelled; absent otherwise.

filled_quote.description: What actually traded, in USDC to 6 decimal places: the sum of fill price x size over the order's fills, taker or maker. Absent when the order has no fills. Prefer it over a size derived from the order's amount, which is valued at the signed limit and overstates a marketable order.

next_before.description: Pass as before to fetch older orders. Absent on the last page.

IntegrationTicker.description: A market in its advertised orientation: cNGN priced in USDC. Price fields are null, never omitted, when there is no value: no fill yet, no resting bid or ask, or nothing traded in the last 24 hours.

ticker_id.description: The market identifier, cNGN-USDC. Futures are not listed here. Pass it as ticker_id to the orderbook and trades endpoints. base_currency and target_currency state the orientation.

base_currency.description: The asset priced. cNGN on cNGN-USDC.

target_currency.description: The asset prices are quoted in. USDC on cNGN-USDC.

last_price.description: Price of the most recent fill, at any age, in target_currency per base_currency (USDC per cNGN), rounded down to 10 decimal places.

base_volume.description: Base asset (cNGN) traded over the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 6 decimal places. 0 when nothing traded.

target_volume.description: Target asset (USDC) traded over the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 18 decimal places. 0 when nothing traded.

bid.description: Best bid in USDC per cNGN, rounded down to 10 decimal places. Equals the orderbook's top bid level price.

ask.description: Best ask in USDC per cNGN, rounded up to 10 decimal places. Equals the orderbook's top ask level price.

high.description: Highest fill price over the trailing 24 hours, in USDC per cNGN, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

low.description: Lowest fill price over the trailing 24 hours, in USDC per cNGN, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

timestamp.description: Unix milliseconds at which the book was read.

bids.description: Levels buying cNGN, highest price first. Empty array, never null, when there are none.

asks.description: Levels selling cNGN, lowest price first. Empty array, never null, when there are none.

IntegrationLevel.description: [price, quantity]: price in USDC per cNGN to 10 decimal places (bids rounded down, asks up), quantity in cNGN to 6 decimal places rounded down, summed over the resting orders at that price.

price.description: target_currency per base_currency: USDC per cNGN, to 10 decimal places.

base_volume.description: Base asset traded: cNGN, to 6 decimal places.

target_volume.description: Target asset traded: USDC (price x base_volume), to 18 decimal places.

type.description: The taker's side in cNGN: buy means the taker acquired cNGN and paid USDC.

next_before_trade_id.description: Pass as before_trade_id to fetch older trades. Absent on the last page.

PositionsResponse.description: Read futures and futures_account. Other keys are reserved: they may be absent, and further keys may appear, for example when another section of the response could not be read. A failure there does not affect futures or futures_account.

futures.description: One entry per listed series the account holds. Empty when the account is flat in every series.

positions.description: Reserved. Not part of the documented response; it may be absent.

accounts.description: Reserved. Not part of the documented response; it may be absent.

FuturePosition.description: An account's position in one futures series. Every field except market and sub_id is read from chain and is absent when that read failed: treat an absent field as unknown, not as zero. An entry without contracts is a series whose position could not be read.

sub_id.description: The series' sub id: its expiry, in unix seconds.

status.description: trading before last_trade_time; closing after it until the settlement price is fixed; settled after that.

contracts.description: Signed contracts, up to 18 decimal places. Positive is a long.

side.description: long is long USDC: it gains when the naira weakens and the price, in cNGN per USDC, rises.

mark_price.description: The series' mark, in cNGN per USDC. Once settled, the settlement price.

mark_updated_at.description: When the mark was set; once settled, when the series settled.

pending_vm_cngn.description: Variation margin accrued since the account's last settlement and not yet paid into cash, in cNGN. Positive is owed to the account. Variation margin accrues at each mark and is realised at each settlement.

FuturesAccount.description: The account's margin under the MarginEngine. It covers every series and the cNGN the account holds, so it is reported once, not per position. Absent when the account is under another manager. A surplus the venue could not read is left out.

im_surplus_usd.description: Initial-margin surplus in USD. Below zero, the account cannot open or add to a position.

mm_surplus_usd.description: Maintenance-margin surplus in USD. Below zero, the account is liquidated.

UnknownMarketResponse.description: The 400 from GET /v1/book, GET /v1/trades and GET /v1/candles when the request names no listed market.

message.description: no such market: <identifier> when the symbol or asset_address + sub_id matched nothing; symbol or asset_address is required when the request named no market.

markets.description: The canonical identifiers the venue accepts, in listing order. Deprecated aliases are accepted but not listed.
